description:
A short download link to a ZIP of what a build was made from.

    For an upload (`npx layero@latest deploy`) the ZIP holds the uploaded
    sources; for a site published with `publish_site` — the published files.
    `.env*` files are left out. Needs a member who can deploy (editor role).
    The link works for 5 minutes: hand it to the person, do not fetch it
    yourself unless they asked you to work with the files.

    A build made from a repository has no stored sources — you get the commit
    link instead. Old uploads may be gone: the platform keeps sources 7 days,
    and the live build while it is live.

deploy.description: id of the build (from list_deploys). Without it — the build served on the project address.
deploy.title: Deploy

project.description: The project: its slug (`my-site`) or id, as listed by `my_projects`. The site address works too (`https://clear-garden-vypm.layero.app` or just `clear-garden-vypm`) — note that the address host is NOT always the slug.
project.title: Project
